integrity: The full formulas are independently derived in RESULT.md and direct pair sampling/quadrature are checked with the included standalone script. The numerical checker is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Theorems apply only to Hilbert cross-ratio distance in simplices, independent symmetric Dirichlet sampling, and fixed concentration for high-dimensional limits. External historical priority and other sampling laws remain open.
title: Dirichlet–Hilbert pair distances on simplices: exact laws and two-Gumbel extremes
